software.name: EESSI
software.description: The European Environment for Scientific Software Installations (EESSI, pronounced as easy) is a collaboration between different European partners in HPC community. The goal of this project is to build a common stack of scientific software installations for HPC systems and beyond, including laptops, personal workstations and cloud infrastructure.
